observations: Two photos show a pile/rows of motivational/business/self-development books laid on tiled floor.

Visible titles include: “Influence People”, “Small Business Big Money”, “Compound Effect”, “Zero to One”, “The Millionaire Next Door”, “This Is Marketing”, “Seth Godin”, “How to Speak and Think”, “Women Rise Up”, “Sell Like Crazy”, “Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage”, “The Millionaire”, “Midas Touch”, “Spiritual Authority”, and “Psychology of Money” (some titles partially obscured).
Books appear clean and dry; no obvious water damage visible in the photos.
No scale, no weighing receipt, and no packaging/quantity count is shown.

claims.claim: Mativational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show multiple motivational/business/self-help/relationship-themed book covers (e.g., “Zero to One”, “This Is Marketing”, “Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage”, “Women Rise Up”).

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos show books laid out and no obvious water staining, but there is no close-up of pages/spines/edges and no proof of “sorted” or “no water added” beyond appearance.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No certified scale, weighing screen, receipt, or timestamp is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Actual quantity/weight may be far less than claimed (500 kg), affecting value per kg.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the certified scale reading with the full stack on it (including the scale brand/model or certification label) and the timestamp.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller mixed bundle of used books (worst case: not 500 kg).

risks.risk: Some books may be damaged (missing pages, torn covers, heavy foxing, mold) even if covers look fine.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of book spines and page edges + open 2–3 random books to show inner pages (no mold spots/tears).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used books with possible wear (worst case: not guaranteed “clean/dry” internally).

risks.risk: Mix may include low-value titles/editions or duplicates; buyer may not get the specific set implied by the visible covers.
risks.proof: A full inventory list or a video panning across all books showing titles/editions, or at least a count of books per title.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an average mixed bundle (worst case: many common/low-demand titles).

risks.risk: Condition grading uncertainty (new vs fairly used vs heavily used) impacts resale value.
risks.proof: Photos of corners, spine condition, and one open book showing page condition for 5 random picks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fairly used condition (worst case: not near-new).

proof_requests: Send a video of the weighing process on the certified scale showing the full bundle and the final reading (with timestamp).
Send close-ups of 5 random books: spine, page edges, and one open page each to confirm no mold/tears/soiling.
Send a quick inventory/count method: either total number of books or a title list (or video showing all titles clearly).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a mixed set of motivational/business/self-development books, but the key pricing driver—claimed 500 kg on a certified scale—and internal condition are not verifiable from the images. Proof of weight and condition is needed before a confident price.
